strategy: Adapt the existing repair_governance ChangePermit chain to the dispatcher WriteAuthorityGuard protocol, extracting exact requested paths for workspace write, commit, and pull-request creation while denying merge. Add one durable local HumanGateAdapter that derives its choices from the verified Workflow routes, persists a task/workflow/step-bound gate contract, and accepts only a sealed decision artifact created by an explicit authoring command. Wire both adapters through a closed v2 concrete Host bootstrap generated by host-init.

changes.responsibility: validate the active contract/ChangePermit and exact mutation paths for every mutating dispatch
changes.reason: the dispatcher protocol has no concrete existing-authority adapter

changes.responsibility: persist exact gate contracts, seal explicit decisions, and resume only the same gate with a durable decision artifact
changes.reason: the concrete factory has no Human Gate implementation

changes.responsibility: validate v2 authority/gate settings and inject the two concrete adapters
changes.reason: the trusted factory is the composition boundary

changes.responsibility: generate closed non-authorizing authority and Human Gate settings
changes.reason: operators should not hand-write bootstrap configuration

changes.responsibility: create one explicit sealed Human Gate decision artifact from a persisted gate contract
changes.reason: users should not hand-write decision JSON
authority and gate configuration must be reviewable and validated

changes.responsibility: prove exact permit binding, path scope, merge denial, durable gate/decision binding, and negative paths
changes.reason: new authority boundaries require adversarial focused tests

changes.responsibility: update initializer/factory integration assertions for real adapter injection
changes.reason: the existing end-to-end bootstrap test must cover the successor composition

changes.responsibility: document automatic governed writes versus true human decisions and exact commands
changes.reason: operators need a concrete interaction model

changes.responsibility: replace the #2098 stopping boundary with the real adapter lifecycle
changes.reason: bootstrap documentation must match the live factory

unchanged_boundaries: repair_governance remains the only ChangePermit validator and permit_path_decision owner
WorkflowAdapterDispatcher remains the only pre-effect guard call site
Capability activation remains Provider selection authority
StarterHostOrchestrator remains Host session ordering authority
TaskRun remains lifecycle and completion authority
merge requires an independent MergeAuthorityGuard and remains unavailable
customer application source and production dependencies remain independent
forbidden_repairs: Do not generate an allow-all permit or infer authority from initialization, selection, CONFIRM, workflow binding, CI, or Quality.
Do not permit a path absent from the active ChangePermit.
Do not authorize pull-request merge with the generic write guard.
Do not accept an inline or stale Human Gate decision without an exact sealed local artifact.
Do not let Human Gate decision create write, completion, release, merge, or production authority.
Do not create a second TaskRun writer, repair controller, Judge, completion policy, or merge adapter.
Do not change services, web, contracts, or standalone product dependencies.
required_invariants: every mutating dispatch reloads and validates the active ChangePermit chain
target_ref carries the exact active change_id and permit_digest but cannot broaden them
workspace, commit, and PR creation requests expose exact changed paths before effects
unsupported mutating capabilities and all merge requests fail closed
gate identity is deterministic and bound to task_id, workflow_id, step_id, routes, and gate contract digest
a resumed decision must match the exact sealed file under the project-local decision root
initialization itself grants no authority and missing project governance blocks writes

focused: active ChangePermit permits only exact workspace/commit/PR-create paths
factory injects the real guard and durable Human Gate adapter
authoring human-decision creates a sealed exact-gate artifact
counterexamples: missing/stale contract, change ID, permit digest, path, request, or decision artifact fails closed
generic guard rejects merge and unsupported mutations
decision for another task/workflow/step or altered routes is rejected
regression: dispatcher, runtime, Host orchestrator, Host transport, initializer, schema, and all required skill-only profiles remain green
negative_path: no authority is derived from configuration or confirmation
TaskRun completion and product source remain unchanged

risks: A target project must have an implementing active-change contract and active ChangePermit before a mutating Workflow starts; absence is intentionally fail-closed.
Human Gate decisions require an explicit authoring command after the Host exposes the persisted gate reference.
Pull-request creation requests must include changed_paths for pre-effect authority checking even though the Provider API also carries branch/SHA identity.
rollback_plan: Remove the two adapter modules and v2 wiring, restore the non-authorizing #2098 concrete bootstrap shape, and leave the existing lower ChangePermit, dispatcher, Host, LangGraph, TaskRun, and Provider components unchanged.
